collection.name: Casual English 100
collection.description: 100 everyday words and phrases for natural spoken English: phrasal verbs, idioms, small talk, and common reactions.

meta.note: Claude-authored (no external LLM). For B1-B2 L1-Vietnamese learners. Fields map to lib/types.ts EnrichableFields; ipa intentionally left blank per captain. Packs are strictly disjoint. 'category' is metadata for review/tagging.

words.vi_meaning: đi chơi, tụ tập (thư giãn cùng nhau)
words.definition_en: to spend time relaxing with people
words.example_complex: Do you want to hang out later, or are you too busy this evening?

words.vi_meaning: thư giãn, bình tĩnh lại
words.definition_en: to relax and stop worrying
words.example_simple: Let's chill out and watch a movie.
words.example_complex: You've been working all day — you should chill out for a while before dinner.

words.vi_meaning: gặp lại và cập nhật tin tức; theo kịp
words.definition_en: to meet and share recent news, or to reach the same level as others
collocations: catch up with an old friend
words.example_complex: We hadn't seen each other in years, so we spent hours catching up over coffee.

words.vi_meaning: xuất hiện, đến (nơi hẹn)
words.definition_en: to arrive, especially at an event
words.example_simple: He didn't show up to the party.
words.example_complex: Half the guests showed up an hour late, so we started without them.

words.vi_meaning: từ bỏ, bỏ cuộc
words.definition_en: to stop trying, or to quit a habit
words.example_complex: After failing twice, she almost gave up, but her friends convinced her to try once more.

words.vi_meaning: tìm ra, hiểu ra (cách làm gì đó)
words.definition_en: to understand or solve something after thinking
words.example_simple: I can't figure out this puzzle.
words.example_complex: It took me a while to figure out why the app kept crashing.

words.vi_meaning: hết, cạn (thứ gì đó)
words.definition_en: to have no more of something left
words.example_complex: We ran out of time before we could finish the last question on the exam.

words.vi_meaning: mong chờ, háo hức
words.definition_en: to feel excited about something that will happen
words.example_simple: I look forward to the holidays.
words.example_complex: I'm really looking forward to seeing you again after all this time.
words.false_friend_note: Followed by a noun or -ing, not the base verb: 'look forward to meeting', not 'to meet'.

words.vi_meaning: trì hoãn, hoãn lại
words.definition_en: to delay something to a later time
words.example_complex: We had to put off the trip because the weather was terrible.

words.vi_meaning: tình cờ gặp/thấy; tạo ấn tượng
words.definition_en: to find something by chance, or to give a certain impression
words.example_simple: I came across an old photo.
words.example_complex: He comes across as shy, but once you know him he's really funny.

words.vi_meaning: hòa hợp, hợp nhau với ai
words.definition_en: to have a good relationship with someone
words.example_simple: I get along with my neighbours.
words.example_complex: The two of them get along surprisingly well, despite having very different personalities.

words.vi_meaning: nhắc đến, đề cập; nuôi dạy
words.definition_en: to mention a topic, or to raise a child
collocations: brought up in a small town
words.example_complex: She brought up an interesting point that no one had considered before.

words.vi_meaning: xuất hiện; tăng âm lượng
words.definition_en: to arrive unexpectedly, or to increase volume
words.example_simple: He turned up at my door.
words.example_complex: Can you turn up the volume? I can barely hear the song.

words.vi_meaning: tập thể dục; giải quyết ổn thỏa
words.definition_en: to exercise, or for a situation to end well
words.example_simple: I work out three times a week.
words.example_complex: Don't worry too much — I'm sure everything will work out in the end.

words.vi_meaning: xem thử, kiểm tra; trả phòng
words.definition_en: to look at or try something, or to leave a hotel
words.example_complex: You should check out that new restaurant — everyone says the food is amazing.

words.vi_meaning: rốt cuộc, cuối cùng lại (ở tình huống nào đó)
words.definition_en: to finally be in a particular place or situation
words.example_complex: We planned to go out, but we ended up ordering pizza and watching films instead.

words.vi_meaning: đón (ai); nhặt lên; học lỏm
words.definition_en: to collect someone or something, or to learn casually
words.example_simple: I'll pick you up at eight.
words.example_complex: She picked up a bit of Spanish just from watching TV shows.

words.vi_meaning: thả xuống, đưa đến (ai/cái gì)
words.definition_en: to take someone or something to a place and leave them there
words.example_simple: Can you drop me off here?
words.example_complex: I'll drop the documents off at your office on my way home.

words.vi_meaning: giải quyết, sắp xếp ổn thỏa
words.definition_en: to organise or resolve a problem
words.example_simple: Let's sort out the details later.
words.example_complex: We need to sit down and sort out who's paying for what.

words.vi_meaning: cất cánh; cởi ra; trở nên phổ biến nhanh
words.definition_en: for a plane to leave the ground, to remove clothing, or to become popular
words.example_simple: The plane takes off at noon.
words.example_complex: Her small online shop really took off after a celebrity shared it.

words.vi_meaning: vượt qua, hồi phục (sau chuyện buồn/ốm)
words.definition_en: to recover from an illness or difficult experience
words.example_simple: It took him weeks to get over the flu.
words.example_complex: It took her a long time to get over the disappointment of not getting the job.

words.vi_meaning: chia tay; tan rã
words.definition_en: to end a romantic relationship
words.example_complex: He was devastated when his girlfriend broke up with him over text.

words.vi_meaning: tình cờ gặp (ai đó)
words.definition_en: to meet someone unexpectedly
collocations: run into someone at the store
words.example_simple: I ran into my teacher at the mall.
words.example_complex: You'll never guess who I ran into at the airport yesterday!

words.vi_meaning: chăm sóc, trông nom
words.definition_en: to take care of someone or something
words.example_simple: Can you look after my dog?
words.example_complex: While I'm away, could you look after the plants and water them twice a week?

words.vi_meaning: làm hỏng, làm sai
words.definition_en: to make a mistake or ruin something
words.example_complex: I completely messed up the presentation because I forgot my notes at home.

words.vi_meaning: bình tĩnh lại
words.definition_en: to become or make someone less angry or upset
words.example_simple: Please calm down and tell me what happened.
words.example_complex: It took a few minutes for him to calm down after the argument.

words.vi_meaning: vui lên, làm ai vui hơn
words.definition_en: to become or make someone happier
words.example_simple: Cheer up! It's not that bad.
words.example_complex: I brought you some flowers to cheer you up after your rough week.

words.vi_meaning: khoe khoang, phô trương
words.definition_en: to behave so as to attract attention to yourself
words.example_simple: He likes to show off his skills.
words.example_complex: She wasn't trying to show off; she genuinely enjoys talking about her work.

words.vi_meaning: chờ một chút; bám chặt
words.definition_en: to wait a moment, or to hold tightly
words.example_complex: Hang on a minute — I think you've misunderstood what I meant.

words.vi_meaning: gác máy (điện thoại)
words.definition_en: to end a phone call
words.example_simple: She hung up before I could answer.
words.example_complex: He got so angry that he hung up on me in the middle of the conversation.

words.vi_meaning: phát hiện, tìm ra (thông tin)
words.definition_en: to learn or discover a fact
words.example_simple: I just found out the news.
words.example_complex: How did you find out that they were planning a surprise party?

words.vi_meaning: tiếp tục; xảy ra
words.definition_en: to continue, or to happen
words.example_complex: The meeting went on for so long that we missed lunch entirely.

words.vi_meaning: ghé qua (nhà ai)
words.definition_en: to visit someone at their home
words.example_complex: Why don't you come over this weekend and we'll cook something together?

words.vi_meaning: ghé qua nhanh (không hẹn trước)
words.definition_en: to visit somewhere briefly and casually
words.example_complex: I might drop by your place on the way home if that's okay.

words.vi_meaning: hủy bỏ
words.definition_en: to cancel a planned event
words.example_complex: The concert was called off at the last minute because of a storm.

words.vi_meaning: thiết lập, cài đặt, tổ chức
words.definition_en: to arrange, build, or prepare something
words.example_simple: I need to set up my new phone.
words.example_complex: It only takes a few minutes to set up an account and start using the app.

words.vi_meaning: chịu đựng, nhẫn nhịn
words.definition_en: to tolerate something unpleasant
words.example_simple: I can't put up with this noise.
words.example_complex: I don't know how she puts up with such a long commute every single day.

words.vi_meaning: đi ăn ngoài (nhà hàng)
words.definition_en: to have a meal at a restaurant rather than at home
words.example_complex: Since neither of us felt like cooking, we decided to eat out instead.

words.vi_meaning: ăn nhẹ, ăn nhanh cái gì đó
words.definition_en: to eat something quickly and casually
words.example_simple: Let's grab a bite before the movie.
words.example_complex: We only had twenty minutes, so we just grabbed a bite at the corner cafe.

words.vi_meaning: chuyện dễ như ăn bánh, quá dễ
words.definition_en: something very easy to do
collocations: it was a piece of cake
words.example_simple: The test was a piece of cake.
words.example_complex: I was nervous about the interview, but honestly it turned out to be a piece of cake.

words.vi_meaning: đi ngủ
words.definition_en: to go to bed
words.example_simple: I'm tired, I'll hit the sack.
words.example_complex: After such a long day, all I wanted to do was hit the sack.

words.vi_meaning: hơi mệt, không khỏe
words.definition_en: feeling slightly ill
words.example_simple: I'm feeling a bit under the weather.
words.example_complex: She's been under the weather all week, so she took a couple of days off.

words.word: cost an arm and a leg
words.vi_meaning: đắt cắt cổ, rất đắt
words.definition_en: to be very expensive
collocations: it cost an arm and a leg
don't cost an arm and a leg
words.example_simple: That car cost an arm and a leg.
words.example_complex: I'd love to travel more, but flights these days cost an arm and a leg.

words.vi_meaning: hiếm khi, thỉnh thoảng lắm
words.definition_en: very rarely
collocations: only once in a blue moon
happens once in a blue moon
words.example_simple: We meet once in a blue moon.
words.example_complex: He's so busy that we only get to see him once in a blue moon.

words.vi_meaning: phá tan sự ngại ngùng, làm quen
words.definition_en: to make people feel more relaxed in a social situation
collocations: break the ice with a joke
words.example_simple: A joke can break the ice.
words.example_complex: To break the ice, the host asked everyone to share one surprising fact about themselves.

words.vi_meaning: cùng quan điểm, hiểu ý nhau
words.definition_en: in agreement or with the same understanding
collocations: make sure we're on the same page
words.example_simple: Are we on the same page?
words.example_complex: Before we start, let's make sure everyone is on the same page about the deadline.

words.vi_meaning: dừng công việc, nghỉ (hôm nay đủ rồi)
words.definition_en: to stop working for the day
collocations: time to call it a day
words.example_complex: We'd been working for ten hours straight, so we decided to call it a day.

words.vi_meaning: sự chặt chém, giá cắt cổ, lừa tiền
words.definition_en: something that is too expensive or a scam
words.example_simple: Ten dollars for water? What a rip-off!
words.example_complex: The souvenirs near the tourist spots are a complete rip-off compared to the local markets.

words.vi_meaning: ráng lên, đừng bỏ cuộc
words.definition_en: used to encourage someone to stay strong in a hard time
words.example_simple: Hang in there, it gets easier.
words.example_complex: I know the exams are stressful, but hang in there — it'll all be over soon.

words.vi_meaning: quen tay, nắm được cách làm
words.definition_en: to learn how to do something after some practice
collocations: once you get the hang of it
words.example_simple: You'll get the hang of it soon.
words.example_complex: Driving felt impossible at first, but after a week I started to get the hang of it.

words.vi_meaning: người lười vận động, chỉ nằm xem TV
words.definition_en: a lazy person who watches a lot of television
words.example_complex: Ever since he lost his job, he's turned into a bit of a couch potato.

words.vi_meaning: vừa nhắc đã tới (nói xong thì người đó xuất hiện)
words.definition_en: said when a person you were just talking about appears
words.example_simple: Speak of the devil — here she comes!
words.example_complex: We were just talking about you, and — speak of the devil — you walked right in.

words.vi_meaning: nói tóm lại, ngắn gọn là
words.definition_en: used to skip details and give the main point
synonyms: to cut a long story short
collocations: to make a long story short
words.example_simple: Long story short, we missed the train.
words.example_complex: Long story short, the trip was a disaster, but we still managed to have some fun.

words.vi_meaning: giữ liên lạc
words.definition_en: to stay in contact with someone
words.example_complex: Even after she moved abroad, we managed to keep in touch through video calls.

words.vi_meaning: cứ tự nhiên, đừng ngại
words.definition_en: used to tell someone they are welcome to do something
words.example_complex: If you need anything during your stay, feel free to call the front desk at any time.

words.vi_meaning: giết thời gian, làm gì đó cho qua giờ
words.definition_en: to do something to pass time while waiting
words.example_simple: I read a book to kill time.
words.example_complex: We had two hours before the flight, so we killed time browsing the shops.

words.vi_meaning: hẹn dịp khác (từ chối lịch sự nhưng để lần sau)
words.definition_en: a polite way to postpone an invitation to another time
collocations: can I take a rain check
words.example_simple: Can I take a rain check on dinner?
words.example_complex: I'd love to come, but I'm swamped tonight — can I take a rain check?

words.vi_meaning: bất ngờ, đột ngột không báo trước
words.definition_en: happening suddenly and unexpectedly
collocations: out of the blue one day
words.example_simple: She called me out of the blue.
words.example_complex: Out of the blue, my old classmate messaged me after nearly ten years of silence.

words.vi_meaning: hợp nhau ngay, thân nhau nhanh
words.definition_en: to get along well with someone immediately
words.example_simple: We hit it off right away.
words.example_complex: They hit it off the moment they met and have been best friends ever since.

words.vi_meaning: nghe quen quen, gợi nhớ mơ hồ
words.definition_en: to sound familiar
words.example_complex: Her face rings a bell, but I honestly can't remember where we met.

words.vi_meaning: chưa chắc chắn, còn bỏ ngỏ
words.definition_en: not yet decided or certain
collocations: plans are up in the air
words.example_simple: Our plans are still up in the air.
words.example_complex: The wedding date is still up in the air because they can't agree on a venue.

words.vi_meaning: không sao đâu, đừng lo
words.definition_en: a casual way to say 'that's fine' or 'you're welcome'
words.example_complex: "Sorry I'm late!" "No worries, we've only just sat down."

words.vi_meaning: không thành vấn đề, không có chi
words.definition_en: used to agree easily or respond to thanks
words.example_complex: "Could you help me move this weekend?" "No problem, just tell me when."

words.vi_meaning: cũng hợp lý, thôi được
words.definition_en: used to accept that something is reasonable
words.example_complex: "I can't make it tonight, I'm exhausted." "Fair enough, let's do it another time."

words.vi_meaning: chắc chắn rồi, tất nhiên
words.definition_en: an enthusiastic way to say yes
words.example_complex: "Would you recommend that restaurant?" "You bet — the food there is fantastic."

words.vi_meaning: chắc chắn, đồng ý
words.definition_en: used to agree strongly
words.example_complex: "Do you think we'll finish on time?" "For sure, we're almost done."

words.vi_meaning: nghe hay đấy, được đó
words.definition_en: used to agree to a suggestion
words.example_complex: "How about we split the bill and grab dessert somewhere else?" "Sounds good to me."

words.vi_meaning: lỗi của tôi, xin lỗi (thân mật)
words.definition_en: a casual way to admit a small mistake
words.example_simple: My bad, I took your seat.
words.example_complex: My bad — I completely forgot to reply to your message yesterday.

words.vi_meaning: thôi bỏ đi, không sao đâu
words.definition_en: used to tell someone not to worry about something
words.example_complex: Never mind what I said earlier — I've changed my mind about the whole thing.

words.vi_meaning: chuyện nhỏ, không đáng lo
words.definition_en: used to say something is not important
words.example_simple: It's no big deal, don't worry.
words.example_complex: I know I forgot your birthday, but making it up to you is no big deal — let's celebrate this weekend.

words.vi_meaning: chào, dạo này sao rồi / có chuyện gì
words.definition_en: a casual greeting or a way to ask what is happening
words.example_complex: What's up? You seem a little quiet today — is everything okay?

words.vi_meaning: dạo này thế nào, khỏe không
words.definition_en: a casual way to ask how someone is
words.example_complex: How's it going? I haven't seen you around campus in ages.

words.vi_meaning: bảo trọng, giữ gìn sức khỏe (khi chào tạm biệt)
words.definition_en: a friendly way to say goodbye
words.example_complex: It was great catching up — take care, and let's do this again soon.

words.vi_meaning: hẹn gặp lại sau
words.definition_en: a casual way to say goodbye
words.example_complex: I've got to run to class now, but catch you later at the cafeteria.

words.vi_meaning: tôi ổn; tôi không cần đâu (từ chối lịch sự)
words.definition_en: used to say you are fine, or to politely decline
words.example_complex: "Should I order you a dessert too?" "I'm good — I'm completely full."

words.vi_meaning: đại loại là, hơi hơi
words.definition_en: used to say something is partly true or vague
words.example_complex: The movie was kind of boring, but the ending kind of made up for it.
words.false_friend_note: Often spoken as 'kinda' in casual speech.

words.vi_meaning: tuyệt vời, hết sảy
words.definition_en: extremely good; used to show enthusiasm
words.example_complex: You got the job? That's absolutely awesome — congratulations!

words.vi_meaning: hiểu rồi, nắm rồi (thân mật)
words.definition_en: an informal way to say 'I understand'
words.example_complex: "So we meet at nine, not ten." "Gotcha, I'll set an alarm."
words.false_friend_note: Casual only; use 'I understand' or 'got it' in formal settings.

words.vi_meaning: thư giãn đi, đừng căng thẳng; tạm biệt nhẹ nhàng
words.definition_en: used to tell someone to relax, or as a friendly goodbye
words.example_complex: You've been so stressed lately — take it easy for a few days and get some rest.

words.vi_meaning: chúc mừng, tốt cho bạn quá
words.definition_en: used to show approval of someone's good news
words.example_simple: You quit smoking? Good for you!
words.example_complex: You finally stood up for yourself at work? Good for you — that took real courage.
words.false_friend_note: Tone matters: said warmly it's genuine praise; said flatly it can sound sarcastic.

words.vi_meaning: ý tôi là (để giải thích/sửa lại)
words.definition_en: used to explain or correct what you just said
words.example_simple: I mean, it's not that bad.
words.example_complex: I mean, I like the idea in theory, but I'm not sure we can afford it right now.

words.vi_meaning: thành thật mà nói
words.definition_en: used before giving your true opinion
words.example_simple: To be honest, I didn't like it.
words.example_complex: To be honest, I wasn't expecting much, but the show turned out to be brilliant.

words.vi_meaning: thôi nào, đi mà (giục hoặc khích lệ/ngờ vực)
words.definition_en: used to encourage, hurry, or express disbelief
collocations: come on, you can do it
words.example_complex: Come on, you don't really believe that story, do you?

words.vi_meaning: đố biết chuyện gì, này biết gì không (dẫn tin)
words.definition_en: used to introduce exciting news
words.example_simple: Guess what! I passed the test.
words.example_complex: Guess what — I ran into your brother today and he says hi!

words.vi_meaning: bạn biết gì không, à mà (dẫn ý mới)
words.definition_en: used to introduce a thought or a change of mind
words.example_simple: You know what, let's just go.
words.example_complex: You know what, on second thought, maybe we should stay in tonight instead.

words.vi_meaning: sao cũng được; mặc kệ (đôi khi bất cần)
words.definition_en: used to show you don't mind, or that you don't care
words.example_complex: "You could at least apologise." "Whatever." — said flatly, it sounds dismissive and rude.
words.false_friend_note: As a one-word reply it often sounds dismissive or rude; use 'either is fine' to sound polite.

words.vi_meaning: thực ra, thật ra là
words.definition_en: used to correct, clarify, or add a surprising fact
words.example_complex: I thought I'd hate the class, but actually it's become my favourite.

words.vi_meaning: về cơ bản, nói đơn giản là
words.definition_en: used to summarise or simplify something
words.example_complex: Basically, the plan is to save up this year and then travel around Asia next summer.

words.vi_meaning: thật lòng mà nói, thật ra
words.definition_en: used to emphasise that you are being truthful
words.example_complex: Honestly, I have no idea how they finished the whole project in a single night.

words.vi_meaning: đúng nghĩa đen; (đôi khi dùng để nhấn mạnh)
words.definition_en: in the exact sense; also used casually for emphasis
words.example_complex: Everyone was there — and I mean literally the entire class showed up.
words.false_friend_note: In casual speech it's often used for emphasis, not its strict 'exactly true' meaning.

words.vi_meaning: dù sao thì; thôi (đổi chủ đề)
words.definition_en: used to change the subject or return to a main point
words.example_complex: It's a long story and not very interesting — anyway, how have you been lately?

words.vi_meaning: à mà, nhân tiện
words.definition_en: used to add a related comment or new topic
words.example_complex: By the way, I meant to ask — did you ever hear back about that job application?

words.vi_meaning: chắc là, tôi đoán vậy (không chắc lắm)
words.definition_en: used to show mild agreement or uncertainty
words.example_complex: I guess we could try the new place, though I'm not really in the mood for spicy food.

words.vi_meaning: bạn biết đấy (từ đệm khi nói)
words.definition_en: a filler used to check the listener follows or to pause
words.example_simple: It was, you know, kind of awkward.
words.example_complex: I just needed some time alone, you know, to figure out what I actually wanted.
words.false_friend_note: A filler; overusing it can sound hesitant, so use it sparingly.

words.vi_meaning: đại khái, kiểu kiểu, hơi hơi
words.definition_en: used to make a statement less exact
words.example_complex: The plan sort of worked, but we had to change a lot of things along the way.

words.vi_meaning: gần như, hầu như
words.definition_en: almost completely; nearly
words.example_complex: We've pretty much decided on the destination; we just need to book the tickets.

words.vi_meaning: không thể nào; còn lâu (ngạc nhiên hoặc từ chối)
words.definition_en: used to show surprise or strong refusal
words.example_complex: No way am I waking up at 4 a.m. just to beat the traffic.

words.vi_meaning: chuyện lớn, quan trọng (thường dùng phủ định/mỉa mai)
words.definition_en: something important; often used to say it is not important
words.example_complex: I don't see what the big deal is — it was only a small mistake.

words.vi_meaning: giúp ai một tay
words.definition_en: to help someone
words.example_simple: Can you give me a hand?
words.example_complex: Would you mind giving me a hand carrying these boxes upstairs?

words.vi_meaning: đến được, tham dự được; thành công
words.definition_en: to manage to attend or arrive, or to succeed
words.example_simple: Sorry, I can't make it tonight.
words.example_complex: I wasn't sure I'd make it, but the traffic cleared up just in time.

words.vi_meaning: chơi/đi chơi cùng ai
words.definition_en: to spend casual time with a particular person
collocations: who do you hang out with
words.example_simple: I hang out with them a lot.
words.example_complex: She mostly hangs out with people from her old school, even now.

words.vi_meaning: kết thúc, hoàn tất (việc gì)
words.definition_en: to finish or bring something to an end
words.example_complex: We managed to wrap up the whole report before the deadline, which was a relief.

words.vi_meaning: cho tôi tham gia với
words.definition_en: used to say you want to join an activity
words.example_simple: A road trip? Count me in!
words.example_complex: If you're organising a football match this weekend, count me in — I've been wanting to play.

words.vi_meaning: thử một lần xem sao
words.definition_en: to try something
collocations: why not give it a go
words.example_complex: I'd never cooked Thai food before, but I decided to give it a go anyway.

words.vi_meaning: tôi cũng vậy
words.definition_en: used to say you feel or think the same
words.example_complex: "I'm exhausted after this week." "Same here — I can't wait for the weekend."
